text:
Ava: Hey team — opened a PR to unify function/tool-calling examples with our structured-output schema. Link: https://git.redwood/internal/docs/pulls/2345. Can reviewers scan the SDK snippets (Python + TS) and the migration notes? tl;dr: move folks from ad-hoc string parsing to schema-validated parsing, with streaming examples.

Jin: looking now. quick note: the current TS snippet in the PR calls `response.json()` which doesn't exist for streaming responses. We should either show a streaming parse example or include a non-streaming fallback.

Samir: also, the JSON schema in the PR sets `additionalProperties: false` which will break some older clients that rely on vendor fields. Recommend we relax to `additionalProperties: true` and add a compatibility note in the migration guide.

Marta: from product side — please add a small "what breaks" checklist and a sample failure log/curl output so customers can triage after upgrading. That reduces support noise.

Ava: Agreed. Jin, can you paste the preferred TS snippet here and I'll swap it in + add migration note and changeset?

Jin: sure — prefer this streaming pattern:
```ts
const stream = await client.chat.generateStream({ model: 'x', messages })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  const parsed = tryParseJsonChunk(chunk)
  if (parsed?.schemaValidated) handle(parsed.data)
}
```
Add a short comment: "fallback to `await client.chat.generate(...)` for non-streaming usage".

Samir: one more runtime note: the serving layer may inject a `__redwood_meta` wrapper in fallback modes. Docs should explicitly say to ignore/strip `__redwood_meta` when validating schema server-side.

Ava: I'll add both notes. Also the PR references an internal schema link that 404s (points to `/schema/v1`). Can someone fix that link to the structured-output anchor?

Ken: I'll take linkfix and run the link-checker job after. I'll add an anchor at `/schema/v1/structured-output` so future refs are stable.

Ava: Awesome. Small TODOs before merge: 1) swap TS snippet 2) relax `additionalProperties` 3) add migration checklist + sample logs 4) update internal schema link 5) changelog entry. Who owns 3/4? :raised_hands:

Marta: I'll own the migration checklist + sample logs (3). Ken owns the linkfix (4).

doc-bot: docs CI passed for build. Broken-link-check reported 1 error -> Ken assigned.

Ava: Perfect — I'll make the snippet swap and the schema relaxation commit, then re-request review. Will ping once PR updated. cc @here for visibility and any other concerns about parser examples or SDK wording.
